title: Legitimate Zero-Return Value (0.0) Treated as Missing Data via Python Boolean OR Fallback
affected_lines: Line 81 & Line 89 (target_input.metrics.cagr_overall if target_input.metrics.cagr_overall is not None else target_input.metrics.rolling_1y_mean)
observed_behavior: When cagr_overall is float 0.0 (a legitimate numerical observation), Python evaluates 0.0 as boolean False in the OR expression. It falls back to rolling_1y_mean, which is None. This sets raw Return to None and data_available to False, suppressing Return dimension evaluation.
expected_behavior: Engine evaluates explicit missingness (e.g. cagr_overall is not None) so that 0.0 is retained as a valid 0% return input.
reproduction: Pass SchemeMetricSnapshot(cagr_overall=0.0) to FundQualityScoringEngine. The resulting Return DimensionScore has raw_value=0.0 and data_available=True.
f16_population_impact: 167 schemes had cagr_overall == 0.0 in historical F.16 execution. 90 schemes had valid Volatility (>0) and 77 schemes had constant NAV series (volatility = None). All 167 schemes lost the Return dimension. 90 schemes were rescaled to 100% Volatility, but because active weight sum (15.0%) fell below the engine's 40.0% threshold (scoring/engine.py L179), final score became None. 77 schemes had active weight sum = 0.0% < 40.0%, final score None.
f16_downstream_oos_impact: 0 CONTAMINATION. All 167 affected schemes received score None and were completely excluded from the valid scored population (N = 4,958) used for downstream forward OOS analysis. Historical F.16 artifacts remain immutable.
current_mitigation: DEFECT REMEDIATED in scoring/engine.py. Explicit non-None evaluation (cagr_overall if cagr_overall is not None else rolling_1y_mean) ensures 0.0 is retained as a valid return observation.
proposed_future_fix: Remediated in Phase F.19.2. Unit tests test_f19_2_zero_return_defect_remediation.py pass with 100% coverage.
phase_f19_1_1_1_2_1_status: Documented and confirmed as genuine production defect.
